interface.longDescription: Turn text, photos, or sketches into 3D assets for games, animation, and 3D printing. Generate PBR textures, refine geometry, rig humanoid characters, and bring them to life with animation. Prepare models with printability checks, mesh repair, and multicolor 3MF workflows, or explore Creative Lab to create figurines, lamps, keychains, and fridge magnets. Export in popular 3D formats and save assets directly into your project.
